title: Hospital corridor battery cliff
story: Mains power fails at an emulated cell site, battery reserves deplete rapidly, and hospital communications risk sudden cutoff.
human_decisions: Commander prioritises hospital corridor traffic over commercial services.
Commander approves PB-10 notification to hospital emergency directors.
Commander authorises PB-06 failover to secondary microwave path.

objective.what: Hospital corridor tower CHN-01 fails over to secondary domestic microwave path before battery shutdown.
proof: battery depletion mitigated by microwave offload

schedule.what: Power utility reports grid supply failure at Park Town substation.
M1 detects rising packet loss as backup generation fails to engage.
M2 forecasts site battery depletion within twenty minutes.
M3 attributes anomaly to physical electrical equipment failure.
Gap Analyst audits statutory minimum battery backup duration floors.
Gap Analyst audits requirement to warn downstream hospital administrators.
Commander approves PB-10 downstream warning drafted by Gap Analyst and authorizes PB-06 path testing.
Mobile operator executes PB-06 failover to microwave backup with domestic gateway.
M1 confirms restored communication service for the hospital corridor.
